His subordinate officers Tian Xingshu and Yang Hengsheng charged the enemy line and killed several of their boldest leaders; the main force followed, the rebels broke and fled, and forty-seven stockades were destroyed.
部將 identifies Tian Xingshu and Yang Hengsheng as Qijiang's subordinate officers.

Changyou attacked from the southwest and Qijiang from the northeast, leveling all the rebel encampments outside the city walls.
城外 means outside the city walls; the revision makes the construction explicit.
Shi Dakai broke out of Chongyi into Hunan; the Chenzhou and Guilin districts were all thrown into alarm, and Qijiang rushed to the defense.
Shi Dakai broke out of Chongyi into Hunan; the Chenzhou and Gui (Guiyang) districts were all thrown into alarm, and Qijiang rushed to the defense.
In this Hunan context 桂 denotes the Guiyang jurisdiction, not Guilin.
Shi Dakai fled from Chongyi into Hunan; all districts under Chen and Gui raised alarms, and Qijiang hurried to defend.
Shi Dakai fled from Chongyi into Hunan; all districts under Chen and Gui (Guiyang) raised alarms, and Qijiang hurried to defend.
In this Hunan context 桂 denotes the Guiyang jurisdiction, not Guilin.

Early in the Xianfeng reign he campaigned under Wang Zhen across Hengyang, Yongzhou, Chenzhou, and Guiyang, and rose by merit to subprefect.
The Hunan sequence 衡、永、郴、桂 ends with Guiyang, not Guilin.
At the beginning of Xianfeng he followed Wang Zhen in campaigns through Hengyang, Yongzhou, Chenzhou, and Guilin, and through accumulated merit was promoted to subprefect.

In 1856, at Tongcheng, Yunlan laid three ambushes, slew the rebel chief Zhang Yongzhong before his own lines, captured Lu Sanyuan, and took the city; he then routed the enemy again at Baiwan Bridge in Chongyang and was awarded the peacock feather.

In 1856, at Tongcheng, Yunlan laid three ambushes, slew the rebel chief Zhang Yongzhong before his own lines, captured Lu Sanyuan, and took the city; he then routed the enemy again at Baini Bridge in Chongyang and was awarded the peacock feather.
白蜺橋 is Baini Bridge; 蜺 is read ni.
In 1863 he was sent to aid Guangdong, smashed the rebel nest at Shidang in Yangshan, accepted three thousand surrenders, and at Lianzhou captured the rebel chieftain Li Fuyou.
In 1863 he was sent to aid Guangdong, smashed the rebel nest at Shiying in Yangshan, accepted three thousand surrenders, and at Lianzhou captured the rebel chieftain Li Fuyou.
石塋 is Shiying, not Shidang.
Yunlan hurried to Wuping with five hundred men, ran into the rebels, and was hopelessly outnumbered; Brigadiers He Shizhen and Wang Minggao and Vice Commander Lei Zhaoxiong were all killed in action.

Yunlan hurried to Wuping with five hundred men, ran into the rebels, and was hopelessly outnumbered; brigade commanders He Shizhen and Wang Minggao and vice commander Lei Zhaoxiong were all killed in action.
總兵 applies to He Shizhen and Wang Minggao, while 副將 applies to Lei Zhaoxiong.
In 1862, when Anhui Governor Li Xuyi was released from mourning and went home on leave, he recommended Xunfang as his replacement, and Xunfang was ordered to serve as acting governor.

In 1862, when Anhui Governor Li Xuyi, who had been ordered to remain in office despite mourning for his mother, asked leave to return home, he recommended Xunfang as his replacement, and Xunfang was ordered to serve as acting governor.
母喪奪情 means Li Xuyi had been ordered to interrupt mourning for his mother and remain in office.
